purpose: Freeze the first executable positive control for the PCNER_GPEI route-law contract using SHA-256 translated into a typed declarative JSON machine. This control demonstrates a domain where unique NEXT, bounded working state and a strict polynomial rank are explicit; it is not a SAT result.

execution.workflow_name: TRUMP SHA-256 JSON PCNER Positive Control

POLY_FIND.control_law: At each nonterminal SHA-256 round there is exactly one scheduled next transition.

POLY_HOLD.control_law: Eight uint32 working words plus one 64-word uint32 message schedule suffice for a block; full route trace is optional and excluded from theorem-cost semantics.
POLY_HOLD.bound: 72 uint32 words for the implemented block working state

EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION.method: from-scratch JSON-bound SHA-256 execution compared with hashlib.sha256 and three fixed published test vectors

DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING.rule: No oracle, unbounded advice, representation switch, deferred semantic wrapper or mandatory full trace materialization is credited as free.

key_result.interpretation: The current TRUMP/JANUS Soul progress gate accepts a real known-polynomial deterministic algorithm when its rank law is explicit. The next R5 use is differential: identify which corresponding obligation fails to transfer from this positive control to arbitrary-CNF SAT.
key_result.sat_gap: For SHA-256 NEXT is given by specification and rank is the remaining fixed rounds. For SAT, existence and polynomial discovery of a universally useful exact next action, preservation of one original-N GPEI envelope, and a polynomially bounded universal progress rank remain OPEN.

next_gate: PCNER_DIFFERENTIAL_OBLIGATION_ARENA__SHA256_CONTROL_VS_ARBITRARY_CNF: compare FIND/HOLD/ADVANCE/EXACTNESS/DEBT axis-by-axis and demand an executable SAT witness or fail-closed OPEN for each missing transfer lemma.
